data.name: Osbert
data.long_meaning: Osbert derives from the Old English name Ósbeorht, which is composed of two elements: Ós, meaning wealth or riches, and beorht, meaning bright or spear. This name was popular among Anglo-Saxons, and it was borne by several saints and scholars throughout history.
